optimizedDescription.value: CLI prints baseline project context via GetProjectContext; project-level patterns only; text via projectContextToMarkdown.

optimizedContext.value:
# cli:project-context

## Rules

### Command
- MUST support: `specd project context [options]`
- `--mode <mode>` — optional; `list|summary|full|hybrid`
- `--rules` / `--constraints` / `--scenarios` — when present, include only those sections in each spec content block; if none passed, all sections
- `--follow-deps` — transitive `dependsOn` from `.specd-metadata.yaml` beyond include/exclude; default: no traversal
- `--depth <n>` — only with `--follow-deps`; N levels (1 = direct); unlimited if `--follow-deps` without `--depth`
- `--optimized` / `--no-optimized` — force/suppress optimized-context preference
- `--format text|json|toon` — default `text`

### Optimization warning
- When `llmOptimizedContext: true` and project optimized context missing/stale per `UpdateProjectMetadata` rules: SHALL warn + instruct run optimization skill; structured formats include warning in response

### Behaviour
- Compiles project-level context only: `context:` entries + specs matched by project `contextIncludeSpecs`/`contextExcludeSpecs` (workspace patterns NOT applied)
- MUST NOT build `CompileContextConfig` inline from `SpecdConfig`; yaml config baked into kernel-wired `GetProjectContext` at composition
- Pass only runtime overrides to `GetProjectContext.execute`:
  - `contextMode` from `--mode` or effective-mode derivation (section flags may force `full` when yaml default not `full`/`hybrid`)
  - `llmOptimizedContext` only when `--optimized`/`--no-optimized` differs from yaml default
  - `followDeps`, `depth`, `sections` from flags
- Use case: (1) render project `context:` (instruction text verbatim; file entries from disk) (2) apply project `contextIncludeSpecs` across workspaces (default `['default:*']`) (3) apply project `contextExcludeSpecs` (4) optional `dependsOn` only with `--follow-deps` (5) render per effective `contextMode`
- When baked `llmOptimizedContext` enabled: prefer fresh optimized project-level content
- Optimization bypass for partial sections enforced by `GetProjectContext` via forwarded `sections`; CLI MUST NOT recompute `llmOptimizedContext` from section flags except via `--optimized`/`--no-optimized`
- MUST suppress `stale-optimization` warnings when optimization effectively bypassed (`--no-optimized` or partial sections)

### Output
- MUST use structured `GetProjectContextResult`; MUST NOT assemble agent markdown inline
- **text** (default): call `projectContextToMarkdown(context)` from `@specd/sdk`; print stdout; helper owns entry formatting, full content, catalogue for non-`full` mode
- Catalogue MUST tell agents: `specd specs context <specId>` for full optimized context; MUST NEVER mention `changes spec-preview` or change-scoped preview
- Helper returns `no project context configured` → print that; exit 0
- Section flags apply only to full entries; `list`/`summary` stay list/summary-shaped even with section flags
- **json/toon**: `contextEntries`, `specs`, `warnings`; shared shape — list omits title/description/content, summary omits content, full includes content; MUST NOT call markdown helper

### Warnings
- Advisories (missing `file:`, stale metadata, unknown workspace patterns, spec not found) → `warning:` stderr all formats; also `warnings` in json/toon; exit 0

### Errors
- Config load/discovery/parse failure → entrypoint exit rules
- Schema unresolved → exit 3

### Full mode / sections
- `full` (default without section flags): Description, Rules, Constraints per spec
- One+ section flags → only those sections (headers persist)

## Constraints
- Read-only
- Text rendering MUST come from `projectContextToMarkdown`; CLI MUST NOT hardcode catalogue hints or markdown tables
- Project context text MUST NEVER suggest `changes spec-preview`
- Only project-level include/exclude; workspace patterns are change-specific
- `dependsOn` opt-in via `--follow-deps`
- `--depth` without `--follow-deps` → CLI usage error exit 1
- Section flags filter full-mode spec content only; project `context:` entries always full
- Section flags no effect in list/summary modes
